_comment: Task table for residual TD3. One entry per task; each becomes a dataclass in
giovi/scripts/ensure_task_config.py. Add a task here rather than editing
Class and Hydra names are derived from the task key:
Every field except `dataset` is optional; anything omitted keeps the
ResidualTD3DexmgConfig default. `base_policy` is deliberately absent -- the
wandb_project/run_id of the BC run is written into the generated class by
the launch script, per the README.
